prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save Your New Desktop Pet", "Sign in to bond this pet to your account permanently."]
1: ["Preparing Your Pet's New Desktop Home", "Your companion is getting ready. Browse quick tips below to learn how to interact with your pet.", "Controls Guide: Double click to talk, right click to hide or bring to front."]
2: ["Learn Pet Controls"]
3: ["Pick a Style or Upload a Photo"]
4: ["Sign In to Sync Your Desktop Pets", "Use your primary account email to automatically restore previous pets and keep your collection safe.", "Using a different email creates a separate empty profile."]
5: ["We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!"]
6: ["Pet missing from desktop? Press Ctrl+Shift+P or check your system tray icon to reveal your pet."]
7: ["Select Your Adoption Journey"]
8: ["Complete Certificate & Unlock Starter Toy", "Bonus Desktop Toy Unlocked"]
9: ["Your pet is being crafted in the background. Enable notifications so you can freely use other desktop apps."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions bonuses and free extra items.
